prompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic portrait, golden twilight light, East Asian woman standing at Stonehenge grassland, slightly to the right, full body shot, turning back three-quarters with the left shoulder facing the camera, expression calm, mysterious, and confident with lips slightly parted. Warm white skin, slender figure, deep almond eyes with soft brows, translucent peach-pink blush, fine eyeliner, neutral eyeshadow, and rose lips; long dark brown wavy hair flowing down the back, stray hairs on the left blowing in the wind, warm rim lighting. ivory white silk slip dress reaching the ground, extremely low draped open back trailing onto the grass, satin pearlescent champagne highlights, the back draping close to the feet, right arm at the side, left arm partially hidden by the torso. High monolith occupies the left foreground with gray-brown stone surface lichen cracks; three stone towers stand isolated behind, horizontal lintel on the right, another stone circle cropped on the right edge; scattered fallen boulders, olive grassland with mossy pits and long shadows, hazy distant fields. Sunset sky occupies half, sun low in the upper left, golden halo with thin clouds in warm peach, amber, cream, smoky gray, and light purple, warm light beams through gaps, transitioning to blue-gray in the upper right. Light source behind and to the left, creating golden rim light along hair, shoulders, arms, back, waist, and dress, frontal fill light for the face; warm edge light and cold shadows on stone surfaces, long shadows in the lower right. Waist height, full frame 50–70mm, f/2.8–f/4; sharp near stone textures, softened distant stones, cinematic depth and film grain. Color palette: ivory silk, warm skin tones, olive grass, gray-brown stone, gold amber, peach clouds, blue-gray shadows; ancient, romantic, mysterious, and luxurious atmosphere. No text, logos, watermarks, extra people, modern architecture/fences, artificial lighting, deformed limbs, distorted stones, plastic skin, oversaturated orange tones, or artificial HDR.

promptZh: 超写实电影感人像，金色暮光，东亚女性 站在 巨石阵草地，略微偏右，全身照，背身四分之三侧向镜头，左肩朝向相机，表情平静、神秘且自信，双唇微启。白皙温暖的肤色，身材修长，深邃的杏眼配以柔和的眉毛，半透明的桃粉色腮红，精致的眼线，中性色眼影，玫瑰色双唇；深棕色长卷发垂于背部，左侧几缕发丝随风飘动，温暖的轮廓光。象牙白丝绸吊带长裙，极低的大露背设计拖曳在草地上，缎面珍珠香槟色高光，裙摆垂坠至脚踝，右臂垂于身侧，左臂部分被躯干遮挡。左侧前景为高耸的巨石，表面有灰褐色石纹和苔藓裂缝；后方矗立着三座孤立的石塔，右侧有横梁，右边缘可见另一个石圈的局部；散落的倒塌巨石，橄榄绿草地布满苔藓坑和长长的阴影，远处田野朦胧。夕阳天空占据画面一半，太阳位于左上方低处，金色光晕映衬着暖桃色、琥珀色、奶油色、烟灰色和淡紫色的薄云，暖光从缝隙中穿透，向右上角过渡为蓝灰色。光源位于后方左侧，在头发、肩膀、手臂、背部、腰部和裙装边缘形成金色轮廓光，面部有正面补光；石材表面呈现暖色边缘光和冷色阴影，右下方有长长的投影。腰部高度拍摄，全画幅 50–70mm，f/2.8–f/4；近处石材纹理清晰，远处石块虚化，具有电影级景深和胶片颗粒感。调色板：象牙丝绸色、暖肤色、橄榄绿草地、灰褐色石材、金琥珀色、桃色云彩、蓝灰色阴影；氛围古老、浪漫、神秘且奢华。无文字、标志、水印、多余人物、现代建筑/围栏、人工照明、肢体畸形、石块扭曲、塑料感皮肤、过饱和橙色调或人工 HDR。
